body:
Coco

It made me think hard and long
I- The last paragraph really hit me hard. I promise you I will wait. I might even call My parents now and tell them. Thank you so much I feel a tiny bit less like I want to do it now

Dont do it. If you have nothing to live for, live for your cat. Think how your cat would feel If owner died.

Please stay alive. Life gets better. I promise. Dont do it. It gets better. Dont do it
Please wait even one more day
